name: USSF-627
destination_explanation: This orbit cleans up after itself. Dead satellites in the lowest orbits are pulled down by drag and burn up within a few years.
slot_a_text: A classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches.
slot_b_text: The soot on a landed Falcon 9 is rarely cleaned off fully, giving flight-proven boosters a distinct dirty look.

lg_slot_b_text: B1103 is flying for the 7th time. It came down on the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You, 574 km downrange. Its previous trip was SDA Tranche 1 Transport Layer A, 32 days ago.
lg_slot_c_text: SLC-4E has flown 308 launches since its first in 1964, 70 of them this year. Its previous launch was 5 days earlier.
